heading: The Pregame
paragraphs: The Pregame is an invite-only event series held in unconventional spaces before the night begins.
Every edition brings together a curated mix of professionals from finance, tech, media, music, and creative industries — people who don't usually share the same room, until now.
No venue repeats. No open doors. The guest list is built intentionally, and so is every detail of the experience.
Founded in Washington, D.C. Now operating across multiple cities.
